notes.subject: בחלקלקות
notes.rationale: 'smulsamting' (smooth things) — translations split between 'flatteries' (KJV) and 'intrigue' (BSB); tok i holim piksa bilong samting slik.

notes.subject: חלקלקות
notes.rationale: Double root חלק (smooth) ×2 — reduplication i gat klostu mining bilong 'slippery', Tok Pisin i no inap karim doble smulsamting.

notes.subject: nabzek man
notes.rationale: Daniel 11 i autim tok profet i stap hait — man i no gat nem, olgeta i stap wet.

translation: Na bai wanpela man ol i no tingting gut long em sanap long ples bilong en, na ol i no givim ⟨i⟩ glori bilong kingdom long em; tasol em bai kam insait long taim bilong pis, na em bai holimpas kingdom wantaim smulsamting trik tok.

tokens.gloss: man ol i no tingting gut long em
